about_the_game:
Olderiada: Constellation Of Fables Demo

Olderiada: Constellation Of Fables Demo features three epic battles from Olderiada 

⚔️ The Duskspire Clash – A mist-covered mountain pass becomes the turning point in the war against the undead. Use the terrain and strike with precision.

🛡️ Sanctuary of Broken Oaths – A forgotten holy site where past promises unravel. Choose your side wisely—honor and betrayal walk hand in hand.

🌑 Battle for the Essence of Soul – A conflict over a hidden force that shapes destiny itself. The outcome may shift the balance of the world.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit only)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3-8100 / AMD Ryzen™ 3 1200
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1060 3GB / AMD Radeon™ RX 580
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit only)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-9600K / AMD Ryzen™ 5 3600X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1660 Super / AMD Radeon™ RX 6600

short_description: Olderida is a strategy/action fantasy RPG with real-time battles and kingdom building. Demo of Olderiade features three epic battles from upcoming Early Access release.
